section_summary: This section records 1939 requests for Japanese training ships and transports to visit ports in California and Hawaii, together with U.S. agency replies granting the usual courtesies and noting schedule changes. It also contains a 1919 exchange about Japanese vessels in the Philippines and a 1939 customs dispute over scrap cargo loaded aboard the Japanese naval tanker Erimo at Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Japanese naval visits in the Philippines
subfiles.about: Reports alleged harbor soundings and reconnaissance during Japanese vessel visits in the Philippines.
subfiles.summary: Describes Azuma and Tokiwa at Cebu and a separate Japanese vessel in Malampaya Sound. The Navy urges investigation and possible representations to Japan.

subfiles.title: Treasury transmittal on Erimo cargo
subfiles.about: Forwards a customs report on merchandise loaded aboard Erimo at Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the collector's May 18 letter.

subfiles.title: Collector's report on Erimo
subfiles.about: Questions whether Erimo's cargo loading falls within authorized port courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Lists scrap metal and other goods supplied locally and asks for instructions on customs practice.

subfiles.title: Commerce inquiry on Erimo cargo
subfiles.about: Raises a cargo manifest and clearance issue concerning Erimo.
subfiles.summary: Commerce cites statutory requirements, notes a similar 1938 Shintoku Maru case and seeks State's decision because Erimo is a Japanese public vessel.

subfiles.title: Treasury referral of Erimo cargo
subfiles.about: Refers Erimo's Honolulu cargo loading for possible action under commerce laws.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the collector's report and recalls a similar 1938 training ship case.

subfiles.title: Customs inspector's Erimo visit report
subfiles.about: Details Erimo's May 1939 Honolulu visit, personnel, local visitors and supplies loaded.
subfiles.summary: The report lists officers, visitors, entertainment and locally contributed provisions and scrap. It notes that no soundings were observed and records other observations about access to the ship and its crew.

subfiles.title: Duplicate collector's letter on Erimo
subfiles.about: Again presents concerns about goods loaded aboard Erimo.
subfiles.summary: Copy of the collector's letter on page 303.

subfiles.title: State inquiry on Erimo cargo and tin scrap
subfiles.about: Seeks Treasury's view on Erimo's cargo and possible tin plate scrap export controls.
subfiles.summary: State asks about manifest and clearance obligations for a Japanese public vessel, compares an earlier Shintoku Maru case, and requests inquiry into whether the loaded scrap tin required an export license.

subfiles.title: Treasury interim reply on Erimo
subfiles.about: Acknowledges State's Erimo cargo inquiry.
subfiles.summary: Promises a full reply after consideration.
